# UI Bakery

> > UI Bakery is a low-code platform for building internal tools, admin panels, and CRUD applications with extensive database and API integrations.

UI Bakery enables developers and teams to rapidly build custom internal tools with native integrations for PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Elasticsearch, and popular services like OpenAI, GitHub, Stripe, and Salesforce. The platform offers pre-built templates, visual development tools, and comprehensive workflow automation capabilities for finance, management, and customer-facing applications.

## Key Topics

- Internal tools development
- Low-code platform
- Database integrations (PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis)
- CRUD operations
- Admin panel templates
- Workflow automation
- Dashboard builder
- Database management
- API integrations (OpenAI, GitHub, Stripe, Salesforce)
- Data visualization
- JDBC connectivity
- Elasticsearch
- GraphQL
- Developer tools
- Template library
